dedupe_keys.name: flowfarm jl wind farm simulation and design tool

description: FLOWFarm.jl is a Julia simulation tool for optimising wind-farm layouts. Brigham Young University contributors publish modular wake and farm models with a quick-start tutorial, theory notes and examples. A user supplies turbine locations, rotor and wind conditions, selects wake-model components, and chooses an optimisation objective. Outputs include estimated farm power and gradients used to move turbines or test design changes. Geographic coverage is a chosen site, while time or wind-direction aggregation follows the supplied wind scenarios. MIT-licensed source is installable through Julia and can run on one core, threads or distributed workers. A limitation is that analytical wake models approximate turbine interactions and need checking against measured site performance. FLOWFarm supports renewable generation capacity and siting studies. The catalogue's model-cactus-turbine is a separate rotor-scale simulator prepared in this G7 review, while model-openfoam is an existing broader flow solver; neither was tested as an interface. No wind data or example was executed.
